makemeahanzi.definition: to test, to investigate, to examine

characterDeckComponents.note: 耂 (a variant of 老, 'old') — 考 relates to careful examination and testing
丂 gives a loose sound connection to 考's reading kǎo

meanings: used in 掙扎|挣扎[zheng1 zha2]

makemeahanzi.definition: to struggle, to strive, to endeavor

etymology.hint: To fight 争 by hand 扌; 争 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: Hand — shows this is a physical action.
Represents fighting or striving for something.

makemeahanzi.definition: cannot; do not; is not; negative

characterDeckComponents.note: 艹 (plant) — 蒙 originally described a climbing plant covering something over.
冡 (méng) gives the sound — an exact match with 蒙's reading méng.

meanings: Europe (abbr. for 歐洲|欧洲[Ou1 zhou1])
ohm (abbr. for 歐姆|欧姆[ou1 mu3])
euro (abbr. for 歐元|欧元[ou1 yuan2])

makemeahanzi.definition: to extend, to stretch out, to open up; to trust

etymology.hint: To extend your confidence 申 to another person 亻; 申 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) does the action.
申 pictures something stretched out straight, like a bolt of lightning, giving 伸 its meaning 'to extend, to stretch.'

etymology.hint: A tongue 立 forming a sound in the mouth 日

characterDeckComponents.note: 立 here depicts a tongue positioned to speak.
日 here depicts an open mouth — a tongue forming sound in the mouth gave 音 its meaning 'sound, tone.'
力 (strength) — 劲 names physical strength or energy.

meanings: used in 惡心|恶心[e3 xin1]

makemeahanzi.definition: bad, evil, wicked; to hate, to loathe; foul, nauseating

characterDeckComponents.note: 心 (heart) — 恶 relates to an evil or malicious state of heart/mind
亚 (yà) gives a sound distantly related to 恶's reading è, having drifted apart over time

meanings: lateral component of a Chinese character

characterDeckComponents.note: 立 (to stand) — 旁 relates to standing to the side of something.
方 (fāng) gives the sound — an exact match with 旁.

makemeahanzi.definition: to uproot, to pull out; to select, to promote

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 拔 describes pulling something out by hand.
犮 (bá) gives the sound — an exact match with 拔.

meanings: used in 骨碌碌[gu1 lu4 lu4]

characterDeckComponents.note: 冎 pictures a joint of bone.
⺼ (flesh) sits below, together giving 骨 its meaning 'bone.'

etymology.hint: Jade 玉 kept in one's house 宀

characterDeckComponents.note: 宀 (a roof) — a house where valuables are kept
玉 (jade) — the treasure kept safe inside

makemeahanzi.definition: interest; interesting; what attracts one's attention

characterDeckComponents.note: 走 (to walk/run) — 趣 originally related to hurrying eagerly toward something, extending to 'interesting, of interest.'
取 (qǔ) gives a sound close to qù, sharing the same syllable body and differing mainly in tone.
女 (woman) — 奶 relates to a woman nursing, and to milk.
乃 (nǎi) is an exact match for the sound of 奶.

makemeahanzi.definition: to open one's eyes; to stare

characterDeckComponents.note: 目 (eye) — 睁 describes an action of the eyes.
争 (zhēng) gives the sound — an exact match for 睁.

makemeahanzi.definition: soil, earth; items made of earth

etymology.hint: A lump of clay on a potter's wheel

characterDeckComponents.note: 土 depicts a mound of earth resting on the ground — a simple picture of soil, giving 土 its meaning 'earth, soil, land.'

etymology.hint: A hand 乂 holding an axe 八

characterDeckComponents.note: 乂 depicts a hand gripping a tool.
八 here depicts a hand-axe — a father shown wielding a tool to provide for and protect the family gave 父 its meaning 'father.'
耳 (ear) — an old link between listening to official duties and 职's meaning 'duty, profession, office'
只 (zhī) gives a loose sound connection to 职's reading zhí
讠 (speech) — 谎 describes false speech, a lie.
荒 (huāng) gives the sound — an exact match with 谎, differing only in tone.
木 (wood) — a pole or shaft was traditionally made of wood.
干 (gān) gives the sound — an exact match for 杆.
艹 (grass/plant) — 苦 relates to the bitter taste of certain plants and herbs
古 (gǔ) gives a sound close to 苦's reading kǔ

makemeahanzi.definition: ingredients, materials; to conjecture, to guess

etymology.hint: A hand measuring 斗 a cup of rice 米

characterDeckComponents.note: 米 (rice) — the grain being measured.
斗 (a measuring ladle) — measuring out rice gave 料 its meaning 'material, to estimate, to reckon.'

meanings: classifier for bombs, missiles, satellites etc

makemeahanzi.definition: the stalk of a shrub, the trunk of a tree

characterDeckComponents.note: Tree — originally referred to a tree trunk or stalk.
Gives a sound distantly related to méi, having drifted apart over time.

meanings: (bound form) subordinates in a gang of bandits

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — the mouth radical, marking the character as related to speech, sound, or an action of the mouth.
娄 (lóu) gives the sound — an exact match with 喽's reading.

meanings: dry measure for grain equal to ten dou 斗[dou3]

etymology.hint: A rock 口 at the base of a cliff 厂

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (a rock) — the boulder itself.
厂 (a cliff) — the rock lying at the base of a cliff, the source of 石's meaning 'stone, rock.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to smear, to scribble, to daub; surname

characterDeckComponents.note: Water — early sense linked to a river name, later extended to smearing liquid.
Gives the sound yú, related to tú but drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to take advantage of, to seize an opportunity

characterDeckComponents.note: 走 (to walk, to move) — 趁 relates to acting while an opportunity or moment lasts.
㐱 (zhěn) gives a sound close to chèn, sharing part of the rhyme though the initial has shifted.

makemeahanzi.definition: to lose; to make a mistake, to neglect

etymology.hint: Something 丿 falling from a hand 夫

characterDeckComponents.note: 丿 (something falling) — an object slipping away.
夫 (a hand/person) — the object slipping out of a hand, giving 失 its meaning 'to lose.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to shave; to scrape; to blow

characterDeckComponents.note: 刂 (knife) — 刮 describes a scraping action done with a blade.
舌 (shé) gives a sound only distantly related to guā today, having drifted apart over time.
纟 (silk/thread) — 绿 originally described a shade of green-dyed silk.
录 (lù) gives a sound close to lǜ, sharing the same syllable body and differing mainly in tone.
灬 (fire) — 煮 involves cooking with heat.
者 (zhě) gives a sound close to zhǔ, sharing the same initial.

etymology.hint: A container 凵 of wickedness 乂

characterDeckComponents.note: 凵 depicts an open container or pit, shown here holding something dangerous inside.
乂 is a crossed mark suggesting something tangled or harmful — trapped inside the container 凵, it gives 凶 its meaning 'vicious, ominous.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to lack, to be short; vacancy, gap, deficit

characterDeckComponents.note: 缶 (a clay jar) — 缺 relates to something broken or missing, like a cracked vessel.
夬 (guài) reflects the character's historical phonetic root, though the modern reading quē has diverged.

etymology.hint: Water 氺 contained by a dam

characterDeckComponents.note: 泰 depicts a great volume of water 氺 being controlled or channeled from above — mastery over something so large came to suggest greatness, giving 泰 its meaning 'great, exalted.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to break open, to split up, to tear apart

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — tearing something open is done by hand.
斥 (chì) gives a sound moderately close to chāi, sharing the initial consonant.
世 depicts three leaves or shoots on a stem, suggesting continuous growth across generations — giving rise to the meaning 'generation' or 'world.'
阝 (on the right, from 邑 'settlement') — 郡 was an old administrative region, a type of place.
君 (jūn) gives a sound close to jùn, sharing the same rhyme and a related tone.
艹 (grass) — 草 refers to grass or plants
早 (zǎo) gives a sound close to 草's reading cǎo, sharing a similar historical pronunciation

meanings: classifier for events: time, turn, incident

makemeahanzi.definition: to meet, to encounter, to come across

characterDeckComponents.note: 辶 (to walk) — 遭 relates to something you come across or run into on your way.
曹 (cáo) gives a sound distantly related to zāo, having drifted apart over time.
缶 (jar/pottery) — 罐 names a type of container, a jar or pot.
雚 (guàn) gives the sound — an exact match with 罐.
米 (grain, rice) — 粘 describes the sticky quality of cooked rice or glutinous grains.
占 (zhàn) gives the sound — an exact match with 粘, differing only in tone.
女 (woman) — 妙 originally described a young woman's delicate charm, extended to mean 'wonderful, clever.'
少 (shǎo) gives a sound distantly related to miào, having drifted apart over time.
氵 (water) — sand forms as water erodes rock over time.
少 (shǎo) shares the initial sh- with shā, though the vowel has since shifted.

makemeahanzi.definition: answer, reply; to return; to assent to

meanings: quotient (as in 智商[zhi4 shang1], intelligence quotient)

characterDeckComponents.note: 冏 (bright, a window admitting light) — appears in 商's ancient form, though its exact link to 'commerce, to discuss' is unclear today.
章 — a graphic element whose original contribution to the character's meaning has been lost over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to taste; to experience, to experiment with

characterDeckComponents.note: 云 here stands in for an older form meaning "to speak of, to taste," 尝's core meaning.
尚 (shàng) gives a sound distantly related to cháng, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to accuse, to blame, to curse, to scold

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 骂 describes shouting angry words from the mouth, 'to scold.'
马 (mǎ) gives a sound very close to mà, sharing the initial and rhyme — only the tone differs.

makemeahanzi.definition: to defend, to guard, to protect; shelter; endorse

etymology.hint: Guarding 扌 a home 户; 户 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — represents the act of guarding or defending.
户 (door/household) — protecting one's home gave 护 its meaning 'to protect, guard.'
